title: Friendship
summary: When you need loyal, wise companionship — learn to be a friend and to receive friendship under God's love.
graceGuardrail: Having friends does not prove you are loved by God — and lacking them does not mean He has left you. Belonging in Christ is the centre; friendship is a gift to steward.
framing: Friendship is more than convenience. Scripture pictures loyalty, truth-telling, and shared burdens — the kind of nearness that reflects God's care.
why: Loneliness grows when we only consume company or only perform for it. Faithful friendship is mutual: show up, speak truth in love, and receive help without shame.

steps.title: Begin by noticing who is near
steps.explanation: A friend sticks closer than a brother. Start by noticing who already shows care — or where God may be inviting you to take a small step toward someone.
steps.action: Write one name: someone to thank, check on, or gently approach.

steps.title: Offer one faithful gesture
steps.explanation: A friend loves at all times. Friendship grows through small, consistent presence — not grand speeches.
steps.action: Send one message, make one plan, or offer one practical help today.

steps.title: Name truth and share burdens
steps.explanation: Faithful are the wounds of a friend. Bear one another's burdens. Real friendship includes honesty and mutual help.
steps.action: Ask or share one true thing — not gossip, not performance.

steps.title: Discern wise limits
steps.explanation: Walk with the wise. Friendship needs discernment: loyalty without enabling harm, closeness without losing your walk with God.
steps.action: Name one wise boundary or one wise investment in a good friendship.

whenToUse: You feel lonely even in a crowd
You want deeper friendship but do not know how to start
A friendship needs repair, honesty, or clearer boundaries
You are choosing companions who shape your walk with God
sixtySecond: Name one person to thank or check on.
Ask God for wisdom in who you walk with.
prayer: Lord, thank You that You call us friends in Christ. Teach me to be loyal, honest, and wise. Lead me into friendships that honour You and carry burdens together. Amen.

scripture.insight: Friendship loves through ordinary days, not only crises.
Jesus models friendship that lays down life and tells the truth.
Two are better than one — help rises when someone falls.
